description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what themes/entities does the news associate with X" or "who/what is being mentioned alongside X right now". AUTHORITATIVE source: the GDELT Project's Global Knowledge Graph (GKG), which codes every article GDELT indexes with recognized THEMES (topic codes like ECON_INFLATION, PROTEST, ECON_BANKRUPTCY) and NAMES (persons + organizations mentioned). Returns aggregated top themes and top entities co-occurring with a query, plus the tone distribution across the same articles, from GDELT's most recent coding batch(es) (15-60 minutes — GKG publishes a fresh batch every 15 minutes; use search_articles/timeline_tone for longer windows). Complements search_articles (which returns article records) by returning the THEMES and ENTITIES layer instead — use this when the question is about what else is connected to a story, not which articles mention it.

max_records.description: Sample article records to include after the aggregates (0-25, default 5).

minutes.description: How far back to search, in minutes: 15, 30, 45 or 60 (default 15 — one GKG batch). GKG batches land every 15 minutes, so this is the most recent N batches.

query.description: Search term or GDELT theme code, e.g. "semiconductor export controls" or "ECON_INFLATION"

name: gkg_summary
title: Gkg Summary
